title: List of sources of resistances
html:
This is a list of sources of resistances. For details on how resistance works, see Resistances.

Resistances

  • Fiendish Resilience: Bludgeoning

Piercing Resistance

  • Fiendish Resilience: Piercing

  • Amulet of the Unworthy
  • Fiendish Resilience: Slashing

Multiple Resistances

All Damage Resistance

  • Elixir of Universal Resistance Gain Resistance to all damage for Duration: 10 turns.
  • Warding Bond Ward an ally. They gain Resistance to all damage.
    • True Love's Embrace
    • Viconia's Walking Fortress
  • Aura of Warding - Grants the paladin and their allies resistance to all damage from spells

All Damage Resistance except Psychic

  • Abyss Beckoners Demonspirit Aura: The wearer's summoned creatures have Resistance to all damage except ⁠Psychic.
  • Feign Death Put an ally in a protective coma. They become Resistant to all damage except ⁠Psychic.
  • Rage: Bear Heart Resistance to all damage except ⁠Psychic.

Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing Resistance

  • Blade Ward Gain Resistance to all ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage for Duration: 2 turns.
  • Circle of Bones Undead Ward: Allied undead within 6m / 20ft are Resistant to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Slashing, and ⁠Piercing damage.
  • Garb of the Land and Sky Mountainous Poise: While using  Patient Defence, you also gain resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage for Duration: 1 turn.
  • Hellrider's Pride Helm's Protection: When you heal another creature, it gains Resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks for Duration: 2 turns.
  • Rage Resistance to ⁠Physical damage.
    • Frenzy Resistance to ⁠Physical damage.
    • Rage: Eagle Heart Resistance to ⁠Physical damage.
    • Rage: Elk Heart Resistance to ⁠Physical damage.
    • Rage: Tiger Heart Resistance to ⁠Physical damage.
    • Rage: Wolf Heart Resistance to ⁠Physical damage.
    • Rage: Wild Magic Resistance to ⁠Physical damage.
  • The Reviving Hands Aegis Palms: When you heal a creature, it gains Resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage for Duration: 2 turns.

Only Non-Magical Resistance

  • Stoneskin Turn a creature's flesh hard as stone. It gains Resistance to all non-magical ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage.
  • Wild Shape: Fire Myrmidon Resistance to all non-magical ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage.
  • Wild Shape: Earth Myrmidon Resistance to all non-magical ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage.
  • Wind Walk Transform yourself and all nearby party members into tiny clouds of mist to avoid attacks. You become Resistant to all non-magical damage.

Miscellaneous Resistances

  • Abdel's Trusted Shield and Cindersnap Gloves allows wielder to cast  Protection from Missiles once per short rest, which grants a 50% damage reduction from ranged weapon attacks for 10 turns. This effect is separate from normal resistance and actually stacks multiplicatively with it for a 75% damage reduction in total.
  • Creation's Echo Elemental Resonance: If the wielder deals ⁠Acid, ⁠Fire, ⁠Lightning, ⁠Radiant, or ⁠Necrotic damage, it becomes Resistant to that damage type for Duration: 2 turns.
  • Dampen Elements When you or an ally gets hit with ⁠Acid, ⁠Cold, ⁠Fire, ⁠Lightning, or ⁠Thunder damage, you can use your reaction to give them Resistance to the attack.
  • Darkfire Shortbow Resistance to ⁠Fire and ⁠Cold damage.
  • Wavemother's Robe Resistance to ⁠Fire and ⁠Cold damage.
  •  Heart of the Storm: Resistance Resistance to ⁠Lightning and ⁠Thunder damage.
  •  Slow Fall When you fall, you can use your reaction to gain Resistance to Falling damage.
  • Wild Shape: Air Myrmidon Resistance to all non-magical ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage, and Resistance to all ⁠Lightning and ⁠Thunder damage.
  • Wild Shape: Water Myrmidon Resistance to all non-magical ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage, and Resistance to all ⁠Acid damage.

Vulnerability

  • Arsonist's Oil Targets with Resistance to ⁠Fire damage become Vulnerable to it instead. Targets with Immunity are unaffected.
  • Amulet of Branding Brand the Weak: Target enemy becomes Vulnerable to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Slashing, or ⁠Piercing damage Duration: 3 turns or until the target takes damage.
  • Bhaalist Armour Aura of Murder: Enemies within 2 m (7 ft) become Vulnerable to ⁠Piercing damage, unless they are Resistant or Immune to it.
  • Bloodthirst Exploit Weakness: (Main Hand Only) Creatures hit with this weapon receive Vulnerability to ⁠Piercing damage.
  •  Brittle Vulnerability to ⁠Bludgeoning and ⁠Thunder
  •  Chilled Vulnerability to ⁠Cold
  •  Frozen Vulnerability to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Thunder, and ⁠Force damage.
  • Karabasan's Gift Paralysed (Karabasan's Gift): Vulnerability to ⁠Bludgeoning,⁠Slashing and⁠Piercing damage.
  • Poisoner's Ring Virulent Venom: Make up to three enemies vulnerable to ⁠Poison unless they succeed a Consitution saving throw.
  • Resonance Stone All creatures within 9 m (30 ft) are  Steeped in Bliss, which includes Vulnerability to ⁠Psychic.
  •  Stricken With Flesh Rot Vulnerability to all damage.
  •  Wet Vulnerability to ⁠Cold and ⁠Lightning
    • Carafe of Water
    • Create or Destroy Water
    • Healing Vapours
    • Minor Conjuration: Create Water
    • Trident of the Waves
    • Water

Allies Only

  • Amulet of the Unworthy Vulnerability to ⁠Bludgeoning
  • Reverse Rain Cloak Vulnerability to ⁠Cold and ⁠Lightning

Immunity

  •  Purity of Body Immunity to ⁠Poison
  • Wild Shape: Air Myrmidon Immunity to ⁠Poison
  • Wild Shape: Fire Myrmidon Immunity to ⁠Fire and ⁠Poison
  • Wild Shape: Earth Myrmidon Immunity to ⁠Poison
  • Wild Shape: Water Myrmidon Immunity to ⁠Poison
  • Nyrulna Veil of the Wind: Immunity to Falling damage

Ignores Resistances

  • Adamantine Longsword Lethal Weapon: Ignores Resistance to ⁠Slashing
  • Adamantine Mace Lethal Weapon: Ignores Resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning
  • Adamantine Scimitar Lethal Weapon: Ignores Resistance to ⁠Slashing
  • Bonespike Gloves Exoskeletal Reinforcement: Your attacks ignore Resistance to ⁠Slashing, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Bludgeoning damage.
  • Foebreaker Lethal Weapon: Ignores Resistance to ⁠Bludgeoning
  • Elemental Adept: Spells you cast ignore Resistance to a damage type of your choice.
    • Elemental Adept: Acid
    • Elemental Adept: Cold
    • Elemental Adept: Fire
    • Elemental Adept: Lightning
    • Elemental Adept: Thunder
